_comment: Fallback models for the generated VS Code agents. Use only the model ids of the OpenCode Go API (https://opencode.ai/console/go#api). VS Code lists each id as <provider_prefix>/<id>. 'opencodego' is the vendor id of the VS Code extension OnesoftQwQ.opencode-go-copilot-provider. The runtime uses the first available model: the model of the agent (agents/*.md), then its fallbacks. To add a Copilot model, write 'Name (copilot)'. Rerun ./install.sh after an edit.
